item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 18/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will moderate slightly in the next few days. Temperatures will rise gradually over the coastal areas of southern China. The weather will remain fine and dry. Temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week. It will be windy over the region.
